caption:
Claude just opened its own plugin store, and every submission gets auto safety-scanned before it goes live 🔌

Developers can now publish MCP connectors and plugin bundles straight from GitHub, so Claude keeps gaining new abilities without you ever leaving the chat.

→ submit an MCP connector or plugin bundle from GitHub
→ get auto safety-scanned the moment you submit
→ built on the new MCP 2.0 spec, with interactive apps inside the chat
→ zero-touch sign-in for enterprise teams

youtube.description:
Anthropic opened a submission portal that turns Claude into a growing plugin store for AI tools.

Developers publish MCP connectors and plugin bundles from GitHub, and every submission is automatically safety-scanned before it goes live. It's built on the new MCP 2.0 spec, with interactive apps inside the chat and zero-touch sign-in for enterprise teams.

Right now the submission portal is open to developers on paid Claude plans.

slides.title: Anthropic opened a submission portal that turns Claude into a growing plugin store.
slides.sub: Developers submit on GitHub; every plugin gets auto safety-scanned before it goes live.
slides.voiceover: Anthropic just opened a plugin store for Claude, with automatic safety scans.

slides.label: What launched
slides.title: Claude Plugin Directory
items: Developers submit an MCP connector or a plugin bundle from GitHub
Every submission is checked and safety-scanned as soon as it's submitted
See status, feedback and the safety-scan results before you publish
slides.voiceover: Anthropic opened a portal where developers submit and publish plugins for Claude.

slides.label: How developers publish
slides.title: From GitHub repo to live plugin
steps: Point to a remote MCP server, or a bundle of MCP servers and skills on GitHub
Anthropic checks and safety-scans the submission right away
See review status, feedback, and the safety-scan results
Once approved, the developer chooses when it goes live
slides.voiceover: Submit on GitHub, get safety-scanned, review the feedback, then publish once approved.

slides.label: Under the hood
slides.title: MCP 2.0, with two new extensions
items: Claude now supports the latest MCP spec, built around a stateless core
Interactive UI rendered inside the chat itself
slides.voiceover: It's built on MCP 2.0, plus in-chat interactive apps and zero-touch enterprise sign-in.

slides.label: What it means for you
slides.title: A more capable Claude, plugin by plugin
items: Installed plugins add abilities without leaving the conversation
Rolling out across Claude and Claude Code over the coming weeks
Existing skills and connectors keep working as they are
slides.voiceover: For regular users, it means a Claude that keeps gaining new abilities through plugins.

slides.label: Who can submit
slides.title: Open to paid plans first
items: The submission portal is open to developers on paid Claude plans
Developers will be able to turn an existing connector listing into a plugin
slides.voiceover: Submitting a plugin right now needs a paid Claude plan.

slides.title: Claude's plugin store
slides.voiceover: That's Claude's new plugin directory, an app store for Claude that's just getting started.
